description.en: Forces a match member to always resist being knocked down/dispossessed in clashes (a full "tough" effect, covering both GP and TP), or clears that. Accepts the same flexible 2-4 argument forms as CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN.
True to force toughness, false to stop forcing it.
Team ID (when called with 3-4 arguments) or a character ID string (when called with exactly 2 arguments).
Optional player number within the team; only used in the 3-4 argument forms.
Optional extra mode parameter; only used in the 4-argument form.
Always null in every case, including an invalid call — this wrapper discards the result of its shared internal helper and never pushes a value of its own.

example.code:
// Force a match member to always resist being knocked down for this scripted sequence
CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH(true, "para_cp0321");
